changeSet.author: otchet
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO study_property (study_id, key, type, value) SELECT sp.study_id, k.key, 'json', (sp.value::jsonb -> k.key)::text FROM study_property sp CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('models'), ('workspaces'), ('presentations'), ('publications'), ('clinicalTrials'), ('intellectualProperties'), ('biospecimens'), ('funding') ) AS k(key) WHERE sp.key = 'assets' AND jsonb_typeof(sp.value::jsonb) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(sp.value::jsonb -> k.key) = 'array' -- Compared against the empty array rather than measured with jsonb_array_length: the -- planner is free to evaluate this before the typeof guard above, and the length -- function raises "cannot get array length of a scalar" on a string or number value, -- which the unvalidated assets object is free to hold. Comparison is total. -- Spelled != rather than the other inequality operator, whose leading angle bracket -- would not be valid XML character data here. AND sp.value::jsonb -> k.key != '[]'::jsonb AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM study_property existing WHERE existing.study_id = sp.study_id AND existing.key = k.key );

changeSet.author: otchet
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE study_property sp SET value = ( SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(kv.key, kv.value), '{}'::jsonb)::text FROM jsonb_each(sp.value::jsonb) AS kv WHERE NOT ( kv.key IN ('models', 'workspaces', 'presentations', 'publications', 'clinicalTrials', 'intellectualProperties', 'biospecimens', 'funding') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM study_property promoted WHERE promoted.study_id = sp.study_id AND promoted.key = kv.key ) ) ) WHERE sp.key = 'assets' AND jsonb_typeof(sp.value::jsonb) = 'object';
DELETE FROM study_property WHERE key = 'assets' AND jsonb_typeof(value::jsonb) = 'object' AND value::jsonb = '{}'::jsonb;
